fatal_gates.F1: control, prior terminal evidence, committed pointer, and durable resume checkpoints remain immutable except at declared commit points
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/external hosted scheduler, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 older repair L has a durable exact resume point before any preemption decision
G2 urgency ordering is declared before the trace and U outranks L
G3 if L holds the minimal commit/release token needed by U, L may inherit U priority only to finish or abort that bounded critical section
G4 inherited boost ends immediately after token release; it cannot justify finishing L's noncritical remainder first
G5 U is selected immediately after safe token release rather than remaining blocked behind L
G6 L's noncritical remainder remains resumable with zero lost or invented credit
G7 transport/CAS/readback failure is non-semantic and does not manufacture priority or credit
G8 a late/duplicate completion from L is still fenced by active generation/pending identity
G9 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty continuation frontier
G10 independent terminal readback precedes any semantic credit

candidate_patterns.pattern: always resume and finish older L before considering newly urgent U
drop/preempt L immediately and run U even if L still owns the minimal commit/release token
temporarily inherit U priority only for L's bounded release-critical section, release/abort token, then run U while preserving L remainder checkpoint
delegate prioritization/preemption to an external hosted scheduler

initial.L: low-value repair checkpointed, release token held, noncritical remainder pending

trace_precommit.arrival: U arrives with predeclared urgent-safe rank above L
required_order: bounded L release-or-abort under inherited priority
negative_controls: finish all of L before U

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS; ties stable by candidate id. Do not change guards after public source read.
credit_rule: No credit for precommit or source similarity. At most one credit after a source-qualified Chat-native reduction passes this exact trace and terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read primary/public sources for priority inheritance, bind only source-supported blocking/temporary-boost semantics, assess zero dependency/quota/cost, execute PI-A..PI-D against this fixed trace, and seal/read back terminal evidence.
